_doc: Derby CHAMP (2026-05-28) — continuation run of the v8 champion (derby-v7-mate-discount: vcf+global-pool+value-discount 0.98+gumbel-m16, small 64f/4blk, the H2H king from v8 round-robin +151). Single lane, resuming from latest.pt @ epoch 2848 / anchored peak 1811.
